content:
Hi Lean community!

I'd like to share a new tool to improve human AI collaboration for writing proofs in Lean.

In Lean Workspace, we aim to create a shared space among human teams and AI agents, and make the process of writing proofs more transparent and collaborative. Some key features include:

  • You interact with coding agents directly on GitHub. A few highlights:
    - It creates a structured workflow: one can directly discuss ideas with an agent in an issue, and after confirming the plan the user can direct the agent to implement it in structured PRs.
    - As such, it exposes the process of collaborating with agents, not just the final outcome. You can inspect and pick up someone else's work and continue chatting with the same agent in the same issues or PRs.
  • We improve the proof writing and reading experience. We built a new interactive blueprint viewer (see the tutorial, demo, live examples). Inspired by LeanArchitect, we also created a simple syntax so one can write in Lean or markdown files to organize the informal proofs and formal Lean code.
  • Lean Workspace creates snapshots for parallel work. For every PR, it automatically compiles and renders the proof in a live website. This makes it easy to see the progress from different collaborators on their tasks, or explore multiple directions with AI and leave feedback in place.

The code is available on GitHub. We also created demo sites that re-render existing open-source blueprint projects — Sphere-Packing-Lean (our demo) and PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (our demo) — as examples; all credit for the mathematics and formalization goes to the original authors.
